trips.title: Japan Art, Design and Technology trip
trips.subject: Art & Design
overview: Get ready for an exhilarating journey to Japan, where adventure and discovery await!
Your exciting trip is packed with a mix of fun-filled activities and enriching experiences that will immerse you in the vibrant culture of this amazing country.
You will enjoy adventures on the famous Bullet Train, enjoy a Kimono dressing experience and, a Sushi making experience among many more activities.
You will dive into Akihabara, Tokyo's buzzing "Electric Town," and delve into the world of anime, manga, and cutting-edge technology.
There will be a fascinating visit to a sumo stable, witnessing the rigorous training regimen of the wrestlers up close.
You will enjoy a relaxing evening on a Yakatabune River Cruise, having dinner while cruising past Tokyo's glittering skyline.
Prepare for a sensory adventure at teamLab Borderless, where art and technology blend seamlessly.
A visit to Tokyo Joypolis promises thrilling arcade games and virtual experiences.
Of course there will be a visit to Tokyo Disneyland, where fairy tales come to life amidst thrilling rides and enchanting parades.
Your trip is designed to create memories that blend fun with education, as each activity offers insights into Japan's rich history, culture, and innovation.
This trip promises to be a once-in-a-lifetime experience that will leave your students (and teachers!) inspired and eager to explore more of this amazing country!

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.description: On arrival into Tokyo Narita or Haneda (depending on chosen flights) Airport you will go through the airport formalities and then be met by your guide who will escort you by coach to your accommodation.The stylish Sunshine City Prince Hotel features 4 dining options and a 24-hour convenience shop. It's located in the Sunshine City complex, only 800 metres from JR Ikebukuro Station. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the property. Rooms at Sunshine City Prince Hotel are fitted with a cable TV, a desk and an electric kettle. Each room has an en suite bathroom with a bathtub, amenities and yukata robes. Nearby Ikebukuro Station offers direct train access to Ueno, Shinjuku and Shibuya within 20 minutes. Higashi-Ikebukuro Subway Station is 500 metres away and has direct links to the Ginza and Tsukiji areas. Guests can find buffet meals at Bayern Restaurant. Musashino Restaurant serves a variety of Japanese dishes, while Kokiden Chinese Restaurant offers Cantonese food. You will check in and enjoy dinner at a local restaurant or your hotel before heading to bed (tired I am sure!)for your first nights’ stay.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.description: After enjoying breakfast at your hotel you will enjoy a Sumo Stable Tour which offers a unique glimpse into the daily lives and rigorous training routines of sumo wrestlers. You will enter a sumo stable, known as a "beya," where wrestlers live and train. During the tour, you will observe morning practice sessions, where wrestlers engage in intense training exercises and practice bouts. Knowledgeable guides provide insights into the history, traditions, and rules of sumo, explaining the significance of various rituals and training methods. This experience allows you to see the dedication and discipline required to be a sumo wrestler, making it a fascinating cultural and educational activity for your students. After enjoying this unique experience you will visit the Akihabara area of Tokyo. Akihabara, known as Tokyo's "Electric Town," is a vibrant area famous for its electronics shops, anime, and manga culture. Students can explore multi-story stores filled with the latest gadgets, video games, and collectible figurines.Thedistrict also features themed cafes, such as maid and anime cafes, offering unique dining experiences. Walking through Akihabara's bustling streets, students can soak in the lively atmosphere, colorful billboards, and cosplay enthusiasts. For lunch, you can enjoy a variety of options, from traditional Japanese cuisine to quirky themed cafes, making it an exciting and immersive experience for your students. You will then visit Asakusa Sensoji Temple, Tokyo's oldest and most significant Buddhist temple, dating back to the 7th century. The temple is known for its impressive Kaminarimon Gate, featuring a giant red lantern, which leads to the bustling Nakamise Shopping Street. Nakamise offers a lively array of traditional snacks, souvenirs, and crafts, allowing visitors to sample local delicacies and purchase unique mementos. The temple grounds include the main hall, a five-story pagoda, and beautiful gardens, providing a serene contrast to the vibrant shopping street. Together, Sensoji Temple and Nakamise District offer a rich cultural experience, blending spiritual heritage with lively commerce. You will then visit the Tokyo Skytree, which stands at 634 meters, and is the tallest structure in Japan and a prominent landmark in Tokyo. This broadcasting and observation tower offers panoramic views of the city from its two observation decks, located at 350 meters and 450 meters. Visitors can enjoy breathtaking vistas, extending as far as Mount Fuji on clear days. The tower also features a glass floor section, providing a thrilling perspective directly downwards. Inside Tokyo Skytree Town there a variety of shops, restaurants and an aquarium. The Skytree's modern design and advanced technology make it a symbol of Tokyo's innovative spirit. You will then enjoy dinner on a Yakatabune River Cruise Boat A Yakatabune River Cruise offers a unique and traditional Japanese dining experience aboard a wooden boat as it sails along Tokyo's scenic waterways. These cruises typically feature tatami mat seating, low tables, and paper lanterns, creating an authentic ambiance. Your students can enjoy a multi-course meal, often including fresh sashimi, tempura, and other seasonal dishes, while taking in panoramic views of Tokyo's iconic landmarks such as the Rainbow Bridge, Tokyo Tower, and Odaiba.The Yakatabune River Cruise provides a memorable way to see Tokyo from a different perspective, blending culinary delights with the city’s captivating scenery. After a very interesting and fun day you will head back to your hotel for your overnight stay.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.description: After enjoying breakfast at your hotel you will be met by your guide and travel to Tokyo TeamLab Planets. Tokyo's teamLab Planets is an immersive digital art museum that offers a unique and interactive experience. It features a series of vast, immersive installations that blend art, technology, and nature. In the Water area your students will wade through water knee-deep as part of the immersive art experience. This interactive installation creates a sensory-rich environment, combining digital art with physical sensations. The water is clean and well-maintained, providing a unique and engaging experience. In the Floating Flower Garden, you will walk through a space filled with floating flowers. These flowers are suspended from the ceiling and move in response to the presence of people, creating the sensation of walking through a garden that parts and reforms around you. The garden is filled with real, living flowers, enhancing the sensory experience with natural fragrances and the gentle movement of the plants. The museum encourages barefoot exploration to enhance the tactile experience and connection with the environment. TeamLab Planets aims to dissolve boundaries between the self and the artwork, fostering a sense of unity and wonder. This cutting-edge attraction offers a fascinating glimpse into the future of art and interactive entertainment. You will then visit the National Museum of Emerging Science and Innovation. This cutting-edge museum showcases the latest advancements in science and technology, offering interactive exhibits and hands-on experiences. Highlights include ASIMO, Honda’s humanoid robot, and the Geo-Cosmos, a giant LED globe displaying real-time global data. The museum explores diverse fields such as robotics, space exploration, environmental science, and life sciences. Students can also engage with exhibits that explain complex scientific concepts in an accessible and engaging way. Also known as Miraikan it hosts special exhibitions, workshops, and live demonstrations, encouraging curiosity and learning among all ages. With its innovative displays and educational focus, the National Museum of Emerging Science and Innovation provides a fascinating journey through the frontiers of contemporary science. You will then visit Tokyo Joypolis an indoor amusement park located in the Decks Tokyo Beach mall in the Odaiba area of Tokyo. Operated by Sega, it features a variety of interactive rides, arcade games, virtual reality experiences, and attractions based on popular Sega franchises and other themes. Some key features of Tokyo Joypolis include: Interactive Rides and Attractions, these often combine physical movement with digital elements, creating immersive experiences. Examples include motion-simulator rides and VR attractions. A wide range of arcade games are available, from classic titles to the latest releases. The park frequently hosts themed events, limited-time attractions, and collaborations with popular media franchises. Tokyo Joypolis offers a mix of thrill rides, family-friendly attractions, and cutting-edge technology, making it an exciting experience for all of you! After this fun filled activity you will enjoy a Manga workshop. A manga workshop provides aspiring artists with hands-on guidance in creating Japanese-style comics. Your students will learn fundamental techniques such as character design, panel layout, and storytelling. Experienced instructors offer insights into manga culture, emphasizing artistic expression and narrative development. Workshops often include practical exercises to enhance skills in drawing, inking, and digital tools. They serve as creative hubs where enthusiasts can explore their passion for manga, hone their craft, and connect with fellow artists in a supportive environment. You will then enjoy a Japanese dinner at a local restaurant before heading back to your hotel for another overnight stay.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.description: After enjoying breakfast you will be met by your coach and guide and transfer to Tokyo Disneyland. Tokyo Disneyland, located just outside Tokyo in Urayasu, Chiba, is an exhilarating destination perfect for students and teachers looking for an unforgettable adventure. Opened in 1983 as the first Disney Park outside the United States, Tokyo Disneyland combines the enchanting charm of Disney with a unique Japanese twist, making it a must-visit for school trips. Spanning over 115 acres, the park is divided into seven magical themed areas, including the adventurous Adventureland, the wild Western land, the enchanting Fantasyland, and the futuristic Tomorrowland. Students will be thrilled by iconic attractions like Space Mountain, Pirates of the Caribbean, and it’s a Small World, offering a mix of high-speed excitement and whimsical wonder. Throughout the year, Tokyo Disneyland hosts spectacular seasonal events and parades, such as the vibrant Disney Halloween and the enchanting Christmas Fantasy, ensuring there’s always something new and exciting to experience. The park’s dedication to detail and its friendly, welcoming staff make it a joy to explore. For teachers, Tokyo Disneyland provides a unique educational opportunity, blending cultural experiences with entertainment. You can enjoy diverse dining options, from traditional Japanese dishes to classic American favorites, and discover exclusive Disney merchandise in the many shops. Tokyo Disneyland promises a magical and memorable trip for everyone. Included in this activity is a one day passport. After this fun filled day you will enjoy dinner at a Japanese restaurant before heading back to your hotel.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.description: After enjoying breakfast you will check out of your hotel. Be sure to take just a small bag for your personal belongings you will need for the next few hours as your main luggage will be transferred to your hotel in Kyoto separately. You will be met by your coach and guide and before you head to Kyoto your first stop will be Meiji Shrine.The Meiji Shrine is a serene Shinto sanctuary dedicated to Emperor Meiji and Empress Shoken. Nestled within a lush, expansive forest in the Shibuya district, it provides a peaceful retreat from the bustling city. The shrine, completed in 1920, is renowned for its traditional Japanese architecture and beautiful natural surroundings. Visitors enter through the impressive torii gates and can explore the main hall, where offerings are made, and the tranquil inner garden, featuring seasonal flora. The Meiji Shrine also hosts various cultural events and traditional ceremonies, offering a deep insight into Japan’s spiritual heritage. It’s a popular destination for both tourists and locals, who come to pray, reflect, and enjoy the harmonious atmosphere. You will then enjoy a Sushi Making Experience. You will all learn from skilled sushi chefs, discovering the secrets behind Japan's iconic cuisine. They'll master techniques like rolling and shaping sushi, using the freshest ingredients. This hands-on workshop not only teaches culinary skills but also immerses students in Japanese culture and traditions. By the end, you will enjoy your own delicious creations and gain a deeper appreciation for the meticulous craft of sushi. It’s a fun, educational, and delicious adventure that will be one of the many highlights of your trip. You will then enjoy an incredible journey into the world of contemporary art at two of Tokyo's most exciting art venues: the Mori Art Museum and the National Art Centre. The Mori Art Museum, located in the iconic Roppongi Hills Mori Tower, offers a dynamic and immersive experience that will captivate students and spark their creativity. This cutting-edge museum showcases a diverse array of contemporary art from both Japanese and international artists. From thought-provoking installations to stunning multimedia exhibits, the Mori Art Museum is known for pushing the boundaries of traditional art. As you explore the museum, you’ll also get to enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of Tokyo from the observation deck, adding an unforgettable element to your visit. Just a short trip away is the National Art Centre, Tokyo, another must-visit destination for art enthusiasts. Unlike traditional museums, the National Art Centre does not have a permanent collection. Instead, it features an ever-changing array of special exhibitions, ensuring that each visit offers something new and exciting. The building itself is a masterpiece, designed by renowned architect Kisho Kurokawa. Its wave-like glass façade and spacious, light-filled galleries create an inspiring environment to discover the latest trends and movements in the art world. Both venues provide a unique opportunity to engage with contemporary art in a way that is both educational and inspiring. After a captivating and fun morning you will transfer to Tokyo Station and board the Bullet Train (Shinkansen) to Kyoto. "Shinkansen" is commonly used to refer to the entire high-speed rail system, while "bullet train" is a more colloquial term used internationally. The Shinkansen network has expanded over the years and now includes multiple lines connecting major cities and regions, playing a crucial role in Japan's transportation system and contributing to its economic growth. The trains can reach speeds of up to 320 kilometers per hour significantly reducing travel time between major cities. Passengers on the Shinkansen enjoy spacious seating, clean facilities, and amenities such as onboard dining and Wi-Fi, making it a comfortable choice. Upon arrival into Kyoto you will be met by your coach and guide and transferred to your hotel. Kyoto Tokyu Hotel Just 5 minutes from Kyoto Station on the free shuttle, Kyoto Tokyu Hotel features 3 restaurants, and a fitness gym. The modern rooms have Tempur comfort pillows and a satellite LCD TV. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the property. You can kick back with a drink from the minibar or have a hot soak in the private bath. All rooms are air-conditioned and include a fridge and an electric kettle. Guests are entitled to complimentary access to the on-site fitness centre. All guest rooms are non-smoking, while there is a designated smoking area on site. World Heritage site Nishi Honganji Temple is just a 5-minute walk away. The Gion area and Kiyomizu-dera Temple are a 15 minute taxi ride. Guests can stay in shape by exercising in the fitness gym, or they can enjoy drinks at The Terrace in the waterfall courtyard. The concierge and 24-hour front desk will assist your needs and requests. Open for all meals, the newly renovated All Day Dining KAZAHANA serves Western and Japanese dishes. Tankuma Kitamise features local Kyoto cuisine while Chinese cuisine is available at Star Hill. After check in you will have some free time to discover the local area and enjoy dinner at a local restaurant before heading back to your hotel for your first nights’ stay.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.description: After enjoying breakfast at your hotel you will have lots of interesting and fun activities. You will be met by your coach and guide for your first visit Fushimi Inari Shrine, located in Kyoto, is one of Japan's most iconic and visited Shinto shrines. Founded in 711 AD, it is dedicated to Inari, the Shinto god of rice, fertility, and prosperity. The shrine is renowned for its thousands of vibrant red torii gates, which form mesmerizing paths winding through the wooded slopes of Mount Inari. You will begin your journey at the main shrine, situated at the base of the mountain. From there, they can follow the trails up to the summit, passing through countless torii gates donated by individuals and businesses wishing for good fortune and success. Along the way, you’ll encounter smaller shrines, stone fox statues, and stunning views of Kyoto. The fox statues, often seen with keys in their mouths, represent Inari's messengers. These sacred foxes are believed to protect the shrines and bring good luck. The entire hike to the summit and back can take about 2-3 hours, but visitors can choose to explore as much or as little of the trail as they like. Fushimi Inari Shrine is not only a place of worship but also a cultural and historical treasure. You will then head to The Kyoto International Manga Museum. The Kyoto International Manga Museum is a paradise for manga enthusiasts, housing an extensive collection of over 300,000 manga volumes. Located in a renovated elementary school, the museum offers a unique blend of history and modern culture. Visitors can explore the “Wall of Manga,” stretching over 200 meters and filled with manga from different areas and genres. The museum also features rotating exhibitions, workshops, and events that delve into the art and history of manga. A visit to the Kyoto Manga Museum provides an immersive experience into Japan's vibrant manga culture, making it an exciting destination for both students and teachers. You will then enjoy a Kimono wearing experience. A Kimono Wearing Experience in Kyoto offers a unique and immersive way to delve into Japanese culture for both male and female participants. The kimono, a traditional Japanese garment, is renowned for its intricate designs and cultural significance. During the experience, participants are guided through the process of selecting a kimono, which varies in style and colour for male and female students. Females often wear more vibrant and elaborate kimonos, complete with obi belts and accessories, while males typically wear simpler, more subdued styles. The experience includes professional assistance in dressing, ensuring the kimono is worn correctly and comfortably. Students learn about the history and cultural importance of the kimono, as well as the etiquette associated with wearing it. After dressing, there's an opportunity to stroll through historic areas of Kyoto, allowing for stunning photo opportunities amidst traditional Japanese architecture and scenic landscapes. This cultural activity provides a memorable and educational experience, highlighting the beauty and craftsmanship of traditional Japanese attire. During the day you will stop for lunch at your leisure and then embark on a fascinating Calligraphy lesson, a perfect blend of fun and learning. Guided by skilled instructors, you will discover the art of Japanese calligraphy, known as "shodo." Using traditional brushes and ink, students will practice writing kanji characters, exploring their meanings and artistic nuances. The lesson emphasizes creativity and concentration, providing a unique way to connect with Japanese culture. As they master brush strokes and techniques, students will create their own calligraphy pieces to take home as souvenirs. This engaging activity offers a hands-on cultural experience, enhancing appreciation for Japanese traditions and art. After an enriching day in Kyoto, you will end your adventure with a magical evening in the Geisha District, known as Gion. This historic area is famous for its traditional wooden machiya houses, teahouses, and the enchanting presence of geisha and maiko (apprentice geisha). As the sun sets, the district comes alive with the soft glow of lanterns, creating a picturesque and atmospheric setting. You will enjoy a delightful dinner at a local restaurant, sampling authentic Kyoto cuisine. As you dine, you might catch glimpses of elegantly dressed geisha and maiko moving gracefully between teahouses, adding a touch of historical charm to the evening. Gion is the perfect way to wrap up your day, leaving you with unforgettable memories of Japan's ancient capital. You will then head back to your hotel for your last nights’ stay.

trips.title: Stunning Geography trip to Iceland
trips.subject: Geography
overview: Welcome to your Iceland adventure! Over the next few days, you'll explore some of the most breathtaking and unique natural wonders this incredible country has to offer.
From the moment you arrive at Reykjavik International Airport, you'll be immersed in Iceland's vibrant culture and stunning landscapes.
Your journey begins with a warm welcome and a transfer to Hotel Örk in Hveragerdi, known for its geothermal activity. Here, you'll unwind in the hotel's outdoor pool, hot tub, and sauna.
You will experience steaming hot springs and bubbling mud pots. You will also enjoy a hike to a geothermal hot spring.

You will embark on the iconic Golden Circle tour. Witness the geological marvels of Þingvellir National Park, the erupting Strokkur geyser, and the majestic Gullfoss waterfall. Each site offers a glimpse into Iceland's rich history and dynamic natural forces.

You will explore the stunning South Coast, visiting the mesmerizing Seljalandsfoss and Skógafoss waterfalls, the dramatic black sand beach at Reynisfjara, and the captivating Sólheimajökull glacier. These experiences highlight the raw beauty of Iceland's diverse landscapes.

Your journey continues with a tour of the Reykjanes Peninsula, the Gunnuhver geothermal area, and the Blue Lagoon, where you can relax in milky-blue, and mineral-rich waters. The following days include visits to geothermal power plants, lava tube caves, and an exciting whale watching tour.

Throughout this trip, you'll have the opportunity to immerse yourself in Icelandic culture, history, and natural wonders, making this an unforgettable adventure. Enjoy every moment of your journey through this extraordinary land!

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.description: On arrival into Reykjavik International Airport you will complete the airport formalities and be met by your driver and guide and transferred to the Hotel Ork. Featuring an outdoor pool, hot tub and sauna on site, this hotel offers accommodation in Hveragerdi, 45 km from Reykjavik. There is free Wi-Fi. Hveragerdi Geothermal Park is 600 metres away. Hotel Örk’s guest rooms include a refrigerator, work desk and satellite TV. Some also have a seating area. The spacious bathrooms contain both a bath and shower. Traditional Icelandic cuisine is served at Hver Restaurant. Other hotel facilities include a bar and games room with billiards and table tennis. Guests can also enjoy free access to the neighbouring 9-hole golf course. You will check in and then be met by your guide and enjoy a visit to Hveragerdi geothermal park. Hveragerdi Geothermal Park, located in southern Iceland, is a fascinating destination known for its geothermal activity. Visitors can witness steaming hot springs, bubbling mud pots, and geysers in a unique natural setting. The park offers guided tours that provide insights into the region's geothermal energy and its historical significance. Visitors can also try baking bread using geothermal heat and bathing in the warm, mineral-rich waters of the park's hot springs. Hveragerdi is a perfect spot to experience Iceland's volcanic landscape and the benefits of geothermal energy firsthand. You will then take a hike to Hike to Rekjadalur geothermal hot spring Thermal River. The hike to Reykjadalur Geothermal Hot Spring Thermal River is a captivating adventure through a stunning volcanic landscape. Starting from the town of Hveragerdi, the trail winds through lush valleys, steaming vents, and bubbling mud pools. After about an hour's trek, hikers are rewarded with the serene thermal river, where they can soak in the warm, naturally heated waters amidst breathtaking scenery. The combination of active geothermal features and the tranquil river makes this hike a unique and rejuvenating experience, showcasing the raw beauty and geothermal wonders of Iceland. After a very enjoyable start to your Iceland adventure you will head for dinner at your hotel before enjoying your first nights' stay. Time permitting you can make use of the outdoor pool, hot tubs or have some fun in the games room.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.description: After enjoying breakfast you will be met by your driver and enjoy a Golden Circle Tour. (A packed lunch will be provided for this day) The Golden Circle tour is one of Iceland's most popular and accessible excursions, offering a spectacular showcase of the country's natural wonders and historical landmarks. This iconic route covers approximately 300 kilometers, looping from Reykjavik into the southern uplands of Iceland and back. The first stop is Þingvellir National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site of immense historical and geological significance. It was here that Iceland's parliament, the Althing, was established in 930 AD, making it one of the oldest parliaments in the world. The park also lies in a rift valley between the North American and Eurasian tectonic plates, providing stunning views of the divergent boundary. Next, the tour heads to the geothermal area in Haukadalur, home to the famous geysers, Geysir and Strokkur. While Geysir, the namesake of all geysers, is now mostly dormant, Strokkur erupts every 5-10 minutes, shooting boiling water up to 30 meters into the air, creating a spectacular natural display. The final stop is Gullfoss, or the "Golden Falls," a breathtaking two-tiered waterfall plunging into the Hvítá River canyon. Its powerful cascade and the surrounding mist often create vibrant rainbows, enhancing its natural beauty. The Golden Circle tour provides a diverse and unforgettable experience, showcasing Iceland's unique geological features, rich history, and stunning natural landscapes. After this spectacular tour you will enjoy dinner at a local restaurant before heading back to the Hotel Ork for your overnight stay.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.description: After breakfast you will be met by your driver and guide and will embark on a South Coast tour. (Packed lunches will be provided) You will take route 1 south and will go as far as the village of Vik and surrounding area. There are many scenic stops including the Seljalandsfoss and Skógafoss waterfalls. Seljalandsfoss and Skógafoss are two of Iceland's most iconic waterfalls, each offering a unique and breathtaking experience. Seljalandsfoss, located along the southern coast, is renowned for its picturesque beauty and the unique opportunity to walk behind its cascading waters. The 60-meter drop creates a misty, magical atmosphere, and the path behind the waterfall offers a rare and exhilarating perspective. A short drive from Seljalandsfoss lies Skógafoss, another stunning waterfall with a powerful 60-meter drop and a width of 25 meters. Skógafoss is famous for its sheer volume and majestic presence, often producing vibrant rainbows on sunny days. Visitors can climb a staircase to the top of the falls for a panoramic view of the surrounding landscape, including the Skógar region and the coastline. Both waterfalls are easily accessible and provide unforgettable experiences, highlighting the raw beauty and natural splendor of Iceland's landscapes. You will also see The black-sand beach at Reynisfjara. Located near the village of Vík in southern Iceland, The black-sand beach at Reynisfjara is renowned for its dramatic and otherworldly landscape. The beach is characterized by its striking black volcanic sands, created from ancient lava flows that have been eroded by the powerful Atlantic Ocean. This unique setting is complemented by the imposing basalt sea stacks known as Reynisdrangar, which rise from the ocean just off the shore. One of the most captivating features of Reynisfjara is the basalt column formations, resembling a natural amphitheater, which add to the beach's surreal beauty. These columns were formed by cooling lava, creating geometric patterns that have become a popular subject for photographers. The powerful waves crashing against the shore create a mesmerizing and often intense experience, reminding visitors of the untamed forces of nature. Reynisfjara's black sands, striking rock formations, and dramatic ocean scenery make it one of Iceland's most iconic and visually stunning natural attractions. You may also get to view Sólheimajökull a stunning glacier tongue extending from the larger Mýrdalsjökull ice cap in southern Iceland. This glacier is renowned for its striking landscape, featuring ice formations, crevasses, and ash layers from past volcanic eruptions, which create a mesmerizing mix of white, blue, and black ice. Viewing and exploring Sólheimajökull is quite accessible, especially in June when the weather is generally milder and the days are longer. A short drive from the Ring Road (Route 1) leads to a parking area, from where a well- marked trail takes visitors to the glacier's edge. Guided glacier hikes and ice climbing tours are popular activities, offering a closer look at the glacier's unique features while ensuring safety. In June, the conditions are typically favorable for visiting Sólheimajökull, with less snow and ice covering the Trails, making it easier to navigate. You will then have some time to enjoy your packed lunches before visiting Skogarfoss and Seljalandsfoss waterfall’s and going on a Glacier Hike. Learning more about Glaciers including the shrinking of the glaciers and the effects it has on climate change. You will then have dinner before heading back to the Hotel Ork.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.description: After enjoying breakfast you will check out of the Ork Hotel and transfer to Reykjavik for a tour of the Reykjanes Peninsular, the Gunnuhver geothermal area and Bridge between continents. The Reykjanes Peninsula, located in southwest Iceland, is a region known for its rugged volcanic landscape and geothermal activity. This unique area is characterized by its vast lava fields, steaming vents, and bubbling mud pools, providing a striking contrast to the surrounding ocean. The peninsula is home to numerous attractions, making it a must-visit destination for those interested in geology and natural beauty. One of the most remarkable sites on the Reykjanes Peninsula is the Gunnuhver geothermal area. Named after a ghost from Icelandic folklore, Gunnuhver is a vivid geothermal field featuring boiling mud pools and powerful steam vents. The area is particularly noted for its vibrant mineral deposits, which create a colorful and surreal landscape. The intense geothermal activity here is a testament to the powerful forces beneath the Earth's surface, and visitors can safely explore the area via well-maintained boardwalks. Another intriguing feature of the Reykjanes Peninsula is the Bridge between Continents. This symbolic bridge spans a rift valley created by the divergent tectonic plates of North America and Eurasia. Walking across the bridge, visitors can literally step from one continent to another, highlighting the geological significance of the area. The bridge is a fascinating stop that underscores the dynamic nature of the Earth's crust in this region. The Reykjanes Peninsula, with its geothermal wonders and unique geological features, offers a captivating glimpse into the natural forces shaping Iceland. You will then take a visit to The Blue Lagoon. The Blue Lagoon is a world-renowned geothermal spa located in a lava field near Grindavík on the Reykjanes Peninsula. Known for its milky-blue, mineral-rich waters, the lagoon is fed by the runoff from the nearby Svartsengi geothermal power plant. The water, which averages a soothing 37-39°C (98-102°F), is rich in silica and sulfur, offering numerous skin benefits and creating a serene, therapeutic environment. The contrast between the warm, blue waters and the surrounding black lava rocks creates a surreal and relaxing atmosphere. You will be provided with Towels and enjoy a soft drink. You will then enjoy dinner before heading to the Hotel Cabin to check in. Located just 700 metres to Laugardalslaug geothermal swimming pool, Hotel Cabin is in the Reykjavik East district. The Sculpture and Shore Walk promenade is just 400 metres away from the hotel, while Reykjavík city centre is 1.5 km away. Guests enjoy free private parking and Wi-Fi. All rooms feature a TV and a private bathroom. Some rooms also have a scenic view of either the city or the sea. Cabin Hotel has a buffet restaurant and a lobby bar where guests can enjoy a drink while watching TV. The bar offers daily happy hour specials. Reykjavík Zoo and Family Park are about 10 minutes’ walk away, while Kringlan Shopping Mall is less than 2 km away. Hotel staff will gladly help arrange other area activities such as hiking, fishing and whale watching excursions.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.description: After enjoying breakfast at your hotel you will pay a visit to an Iceland geothermal power plant which are pivotal in harnessing the country's abundant geothermal energy. Utilizing the Earth's natural heat, the plant produces both electricity and hot water for district heating. The geothermal process involves drilling deep wells to access hot water and steam, which then drive turbines to generate electricity. This sustainable energy source significantly reduces Iceland's reliance on fossil fuels, contributing to its position as a leader in renewable energy. The plant is a testament to Iceland's commitment to environmental sustainability and its pioneering role in renewable energy development. You will then enjoy lunch before paying a visit to a Lava Tube Cave. (Specific Cave to be advised) Lava tube caves in Iceland, formed by ancient volcanic activity, offer a fascinating glimpse into the island's fiery origins. One of the most famous is the Raufarhólshellir lava tunnel, located about 30 minutes from Reykjavik. These caves are created when the surface of a lava flow cools and solidifies while the molten lava beneath continues to flow, eventually draining away and leaving a hollow tube. Exploring a lava tube cave like Raufarhólshellir reveals stunning rock formations, including stalactites and stalagmites made of hardened lava, as well as vibrant colors caused by mineral deposits. Guided tours are available, providing safety equipment and expert knowledge about the geological history and unique features of the cave. Visitors can witness the dramatic effects of volcanic activity up close, walking through tunnels that date back thousands of years. These tours offer a unique opportunity to experience the raw power of Iceland's volcanic landscape, making lava tube caves a must-visit for geology enthusiasts and adventure seekers alike. The caves otherworldly beauty and historical significance make them a memorable highlight of any trip to Iceland. You will then enjoy dinner before heading back to your hotel.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.description: After enjoying breakfast at your hotel you will embark on an exciting Whale Watching Tour. Whale Watching in Iceland offers an unforgettable adventure, taking you from the bustling harbor into the serene waters where majestic marine life thrives. The tour provides a chance to witness the beauty of minke whales, the most commonly spotted species in the region. Alongside minkes, there's a good possibility of encountering harbor porpoises, known for their playful behavior, and other whale species that may surprise you! With expert guides on board, you'll gain insights into the marine ecosystem and the habits of these fascinating creatures. The stunning Icelandic landscapes serve as a breathtaking backdrop, making this tour not just a wildlife spectacle but also a scenic voyage. This whale-watching experience promises to be a highlight of your Icelandic adventure. After a thoroughly enjoyable morning you will have lunch and then enjoy a guided city walking tour of Rejyakvik. A guided walking tour of downtown Reykjavik is an exciting adventure through the heart of Iceland's vibrant capital. You will wander the colorful streets, where every corner holds a story. You'll stand in awe of the towering Hallgrímskirkja Church, explore the futuristic design of the Harpa Concert Hall, and walk in the footsteps of Vikings at the historic Alþingi Parliament House. Discover hidden gems in the old harbor, snap photos of the iconic rainbow-colored rooftops, and feel the buzz of city life in lively squares like Austurvöllur. Your guide will share captivating tales of daring Viking explorers, Reykjavik's artistic scene, and the cool, contemporary vibes of this unique city. This walking tour is a dynamic, fun-filled journey that brings Reykjavik's past and present to life, making it the way to learn more about Reykjavik. After exploring downtown Reykjavik, you'll head to Laugardalslaug, one of the city's most popular spots for locals and visitors alike. This expansive complex is a haven of relaxation and fun, featuring two large outdoor pools perfect for swimming and lounging. The warm geothermal waters offer a soothing escape, while the pools' spacious design ensures plenty of room to splash around. In addition to the main pools, Laugardalslaug boasts hot tubs, water slides, a steam bath, and even a saltwater pool, providing something for everyone.You can unwind in the warm waters or enjoy some aquatic adventures, this visit promises a delightful blend of leisure and excitement. It's a fantastic way to experience an essential part of Icelandic culture, as locals often gather here to relax and socialize. So, dive in and enjoy the unique charm of Laugardalslaug, a perfect complement to your Reykjavik adventure. After enjoying dinner you will head back to your hotel for your last night’s stay

trips.title: STEAM Educational Trip to Orlando
trips.subject: STEAM
overview: Discover the Ultimate Educational Adventure in Orlando! Prepare yourselves for an unforgettable journey to Orlando, where education meets adventure! This meticulously crafted trip offers a unique blend of thrilling experiences and enriching learning opportunities that will captivate young minds and inspire a passion for exploration and discovery.
The adventure begins at the renowned Kennedy Space Center, where students will dive into the fascinating world of space exploration.

They will marvel at the impressive spacecraft, meet real-life astronauts, and embark on the Astronaut Training Experience—a hands-on program that provides an exhilarating taste of what it’s like to train for a mission to Mars.
You will take the excitement to new heights at Universal's Islands of Adventure and Universal Theme Park.

Here, students will explore captivating worlds of their favorite movies and characters, experiencing heart-pounding rides and immersive attractions that blend fun with a touch of science and technology.

The thrills continue with the I-fly experience, where students will defy gravity in an indoor wind tunnel. This activity includes a workshop with a physics professor who will explain the principles of flight and aerodynamics, making the experience both exciting and educational.

A unique highlight of the trip is the opportunity to swim with manatees in their natural habitat. This serene and magical encounter will teach students about marine biology and conservation efforts to protect these gentle giants.

Finally, students will embark on an exhilarating journey through the Florida Everglades on the Boggy Creek Airboats. As they glide through the waterways, they’ll witness the diverse ecosystem and its most famous residents—alligators! This thrilling ride offers a hands-on lesson in environmental science and wildlife conservation.
This is an extraordinary trip to Orlando, where adventure, education, and unforgettable memories await.
It’s a journey that promises to inspire, educate, and excite students, leaving them with stories to tell and knowledge to cherish for a lifetime.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.description: You will depart today from the UAE to embark on an exciting journey to Orlando International Airport in Florida. Upon arrival you will be met and transferred to your accommodation. You will have time to check in before enjoying dinner at a local restuarant and then heading off to bed in anticipation of what lies ahead for the rest of this exciting trip.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.description: After enjoying breakfast you will be met and transferred by coach to The Kennedy Space Centre. The Kennedy Space Center is a gateway to the wonders of space exploration and a hub of cutting-edge technology. As NASA's primary launch center, it has been the starting point for numerous historic missions, including the Apollo moon landings and Space Shuttle launches. Students will have the chance to immerse themselves in the fascinating history and future of space travel. Upon arrival, students will be captivated by the Rocket Garden, which showcases an impressive collection of rockets that have paved the way for human spaceflight. They will gain insights into the engineering marvels behind these towering structures and understand the evolution of space technology. The center offers interactive exhibits and simulators that provide a hands-on learning experience. The Shuttle Launch Experience is a highlight, allowing students to feel the thrill of a simulated space shuttle launch, complete with the sights, sounds, and sensations experienced by real astronauts. A visit to the Astronaut Hall of Fame will inspire students as they learn about the incredible achievements and personal stories of America's space pioneers. They will see artifacts, multimedia displays, and exhibits that celebrate the courage and dedication of those who have ventured into space. Additionally, students can explore the Space Shuttle Atlantis exhibit, where they will come face-to-face with the iconic spacecraft that completed 33 missions. This exhibit offers a comprehensive look at the shuttle program, its achievements, and its impact on space exploration. A trip to the Kennedy Space Center is not just an educational experience but an inspirational journey that ignites curiosity and fosters a passion for science, technology, engineering, and mathematics. It provides students with a deeper understanding of humanity's quest to explore beyond our planet and the limitless possibilities that lie ahead. After a wonderfully educating day you will enjoy dinner at a local restuarant before heading back to your accommodation.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.description: After breakfast you will be met by your coach and transfer to Universal Theme Park where you will visit Universal Studios Universal Theme Park is a premier destination that offers an immersive and exhilarating experience for visitors of all ages. Divided into Universal Studios Florida and Universal's Islands of Adventure, the park is designed to transport guests into the worlds of their favorite movies, TV shows, and characters. At Universal Studios, students can step into the magic of filmmaking. The park features a variety of attractions and rides based on popular movies and shows. Highlights include the Wizarding World of Harry Potter – Diagon Alley, where visitors can explore the iconic streets, ride the thrilling Harry Potter and the Escape from Gringotts, and enjoy a Butterbeer at the Leaky Cauldron. Other attractions like Transformers: The Ride-3D and Despicable Me Minion Mayhem provide high-energy excitement and a chance to see the technology behind movie-making. You will also enjoy a 'Behind the Adventure tour' that will take you to a ride to discuss the engineering and science involved thenyou will all get to be the first on the ride for that day.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.description: Today kicks off with an unforgettable experience at the Kennedy Space Center, where you will participate in the Astronaut Training Experience. This hands-on program allows students to immerse themselves in the world of space exploration and the challenges of living and working on Mars. Using advanced simulation technology, students will engage in realistic mission scenarios that include navigating the Martian terrain, conducting scientific experiments, and solving problems as a team. This unique experience not only teaches the practical aspects of space travel but also emphasizes critical thinking, collaboration, and resilience—skills essential for any aspiring astronaut or scientist. After an inspiring morning at the Kennedy Space Center, the adventure continues in the afternoon with the I-fly experience. At this state-of-the-art indoor wind tunnel, students will get a hands-on lesson in the physics of freefall. The session begins with a workshop led by a physics professor, who will explain the principles of aerodynamics, terminal velocity, and the forces acting on a body in freefall. This engaging and interactive workshop makes complex scientific concepts accessible and exciting. Once students have a solid understanding of the physics behind the experience, it's time to put their knowledge to the test. In the wind tunnel, they will experience the sensation of freefall in a controlled and safe environment, simulating the feeling of skydiving without the need for an airplane. This exhilarating activity not only reinforces their newly acquired knowledge but also provides a thrilling, memorable experience. Combining the excitement of space training with the thrill of simulated freefall, this day is designed to inspire and educate students, leaving them with a deeper appreciation for science and technology. After an amazing day you will enjoy dinner before heading back to your accommodation.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.description: After enjoying breakfast you will be met by your coach and travel to Universal's Islands of Adventure which offers a mix of themed islands, each bringing different adventures to life. From the Jurassic Park River Adventure, where students can encounter dinosaurs, to the Marvel Super Hero Island, home to the Incredible Hulk Coaster and the Amazing Adventures of Spider-Man, There's something for everyone! The Wizarding World of Harry Potter – Hogsmeade allows fans to visit Hogwarts Castle and experience the magical Forbidden Journey ride. The attention to detail and state-of-the-art technology used in creating these attractions make it an educational experience as well, offering insights into engineering, storytelling, and the arts. A visit to Universal's Island of Adventure is not just about thrills and entertainment; it’s an inspiring journey through the magic of movies and the creativity of theme park design. After another very enjoyable and fun day you will enjoy dinner at a local restuarant before returning back to your hotel for your overnight stay.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.description: After breakfast you will embark on an exhilarating adventure with a trip on the Boggy Creek Airboats to explore the breathtaking Florida Everglades. This unique experience offers an up-close encounter with one of the most diverse and vibrant ecosystems in the world. As the airboat glides across the water, students will be immersed in the beauty of the Everglades, with its lush vegetation, winding waterways, and abundant wildlife. The knowledgeable guides will provide fascinating insights into the history and ecology of the region, highlighting the importance of conservation efforts to preserve this vital habitat. The highlight of this trip is the chance to spot the Everglades' most famous inhabitants—alligators. These remarkable reptiles can often be seen basking in the sun along the banks or stealthily swimming through the water. Students will learn about the behavior, diet, and life cycle of alligators, gaining a deeper understanding and respect for these incredible creatures. In addition to alligators, the Everglades are home to a variety of other wildlife, including exotic birds, turtles, and fish. The airboat tour offers numerous photo opportunities and the chance to observe these animals in their natural habitat. This thrilling and educational excursion on the Boggy Creek Airboats promises to be a highlight of the trip, combining adventure with valuable lessons in environmental science and wildlife conservation. You will then have time for dinner before heading back to your accommodation.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.description: After enjoying breakfast you will be collected by your coach and head out to Crystal River for an adventure of a lifetime! Your adventure offers an extraordinary opportunity to swim with manatees in their natural habitat, providing you with a unique and unforgettable experience. These gentle giants, often referred to as "sea cows," are known for their calm demeanor and friendly nature, making them the perfect ambassadors for marine wildlife education. The day begins with a brief educational session led by experienced guides, where students will learn about the biology, behavior, and conservation of manatees. They will discover fascinating facts about these incredible creatures, such as their herbivorous diet, which consists mainly of seagrass, and their unique physical characteristics, including their paddle-like flippers and prehensile lips used for grasping food. Manatees are an endangered species, and their survival is threatened by habitat loss, water pollution, and collisions with boats. This session will emphasize the importance of conservation efforts and how individuals can contribute to protecting these majestic animals. Understanding the challenges manatees face in the wild fosters a sense of responsibility and stewardship among students. Following the educational session, students will don snorkeling gear and enter the warm, crystal-clear waters where manatees reside. Guided by experts, they will have the chance to observe and interact with these gentle mammals up close. The experience of swimming alongside manatees is both awe-inspiring and serene, offering a rare glimpse into their underwater world. The encounter is conducted with strict adherence to guidelines that ensure the safety and well-being of the manatees. Students will learn the importance of respectful and non-intrusive interaction, maintaining a safe distance, and allowing the manatees to approach them if they wish. This respectful approach ensures a positive experience for both the students and the manatees. In addition to the thrilling swim, students will have the opportunity to explore the surrounding aquatic environment, observing other marine life and appreciating the delicate balance of the ecosystem. This immersive experience not only educates students about manatees but also instills a deeper appreciation for the ocean and its inhabitants. Swimming with manatees is more than just a fun activity; it's a profound educational experience that highlights the importance of marine conservation and the need to protect our planet's precious wildlife. After this fun and educational trip you will head off to State Beach Park for Dinner at one of the many Outlets, and also do some shopping in one of the many Malls and Outlet Centres. You will then head back to your accommodation, collect your luggage and be driven by coach to Orlando Airport for your flight back to Dubai.

overview: Explore a world of maths give your pupils the opportunity to discover how mathematical thinking is applied in new and exciting places, and have fun whilst learning with our range of curriculum-linked maths school trips and encourage pupils to develop a real enthusiasm for a subject that is critical to many aspects of everyday life.

Mathematics trip will provide your pupils with a fascinating insight into the wider world of mathematics and will allow them to consider the types of careers a maths qualification can lead to – from architecture and engineering, to finance.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.description: On arrival into Vienna Airport you will be met by your driver and transferred to your accommodation. itinerary.label: Day 2

Transportation from the hostel to the University and back takes approximately 10 minutes by car. You will be picked up from your accommodation at 08:30 AM and returned around 17:00 hrs after the competition. Lunch is included. Dinner will be at your accommodation, and you can then head off to bed (dinner on your own).

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.description: After breakfast at your hostel, today is the second day of the Maths Competition. You will have transportation from the hostel to the University and back, a 10-minute car ride. You will be picked up from your accommodation at 08:30 AM and returned around 13:00 hrs (Lunch bag is included). In the evening, you will enjoy an evening Ghost Tour, which will last around 1.5-2 hours. After the Spooky Vienna Ghost Tour, you will then take the same bus number 11A back to your accommodation

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.description: After enjoying breakfast at your hotel you will enjoy a general walking tour of Vienna with a visit to the opera house (front view only). The Vienna Opera House is a world famous opera venue. With its stunning architecture it is an iconic cultural institution that hosts over 300 performances per year. The Opera House also showcases a rich repertoire of classical and contemporary opera and ballets which are very popular with locals and tourists alike. Then continue to Albertina Museum guided inside visit for 2.5 hours You will also enjoy a guided visit of the Albertina Museum a renowned art museum located in the heart of Vienna. It houses an extensive collection of graphic art including drawings, prints and photographs as well as a diverse range of modern and contemporary artworks. After the tour you will then take 11A back to your accommodation relax and overnight.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.description: Tuesday 27 February 2024 Today you will enjoy a day trip to Semmering a popular winter destination part of the Alps. Semmering is a picturesque mountain pass located in Austria, renowned for its stunning natural beauty and historical significance. Situated in the Eastern Alps, Semmering is a crucial transportation route that connects Lower Austria with Styria. It has long been a vital link between Vienna and Graz, two of Austria's major cities. What sets Semmering apart is its mesmerizing landscape, characterized by lush forests, meadows, and dramatic cliffs. The region attracts visitors throughout the year, offering hiking and skiing opportunities in the respective seasons. Its charming alpine villages and the iconic Semmering Railway, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, add to the region's allure.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.description: 28 February 2024 2024 After enjoying breakfast you will pay a visit to Kunsthistorisches, Museum. The Kunsthistorisches Museum, located in the heart of Vienna, is a treasure trove of art and culture. Step into a world of grandeur and marvel at the stunning collection of masterpieces by renowned artists such as Rembrandt, Vermeer, and Raphael. Admire the opulent architecture that befits the treasures within, and lose yourself in the rich history of human creativity. From exquisite paintings to rare artifacts, this museum is a journey through time and a testament to the enduring power of artistic expression. A visit to the Kunsthistorisches Museum is an immersion in beauty, history, and the pinnacle of human achievement. 10.00 – Museum of Fine Arts (entry included but no guided tour) - Maria-Theresien Platz 1010 ) After museum you may go shopping, have free time, etc. 17:00- hotel pick-up and transfer to Vienna International Airport.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.description: Take an international flight to Japan. trips.title: Fantastic Japan skiing and tour trip
trips.subject: Skiing
overview: Embark on an unforgettable journey through Japan, a country where ancient traditions seamlessly blend with modern marvels. Your adventure begins in the bustling metropolis of Tokyo, where you’ll explore the city’s rich cultural tapestry, from historic temples to neon-lit districts. Each day offers new experiences, from savoring traditional Japanese cuisine to strolling through serene gardens and iconic landmarks like Shibuya Crossing and Meiji Shrine.

From Tokyo, you’ll travel to the stunning Hakuba Valley, a premier skiing destination renowned for its world-class slopes and breathtaking alpine scenery. Over the course of five days, you’ll immerse yourself in the exhilarating world of skiing, guided by expert instructors who cater to all skill levels. The excitement extends beyond the slopes with captivating cultural experiences, including a powerful Taiko drumming performance and a visit to the historic Matsumoto Castle.

As your journey comes to a close, you’ll travel back to Tokyo via a scenic route, stopping to witness the enchanting snow monkeys at Jigokudani Monkey Park and exploring the sacred Zenko-ji Temple. Each moment of this itinerary is designed to leave you with lasting memories of Japan’s unique blend of adventure, culture, and natural beauty.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.description: Upon arrival into Tokyo Narita or Haneda Airport you will be met by your local tour representative. Once you have cleared customs you will board your private coach transfer to your Tokyo hotel. You will enjoy dinner before heading off to bed for your first nights’ accommodation.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast at your hotel before setting off on an immersive tour of Tokyo, a city where the ancient and the modern coexist in perfect harmony. Your adventure begins with a stroll through Tokyo’s historic districts, where you'll find charming temples nestled among bustling shopping streets. Experience the rich cultural heritage of Japan as you savor traditional dishes, each bite offering a taste of the country’s culinary artistry. The day continues with visits to iconic locations like the world-famous Shibuya Crossing, where the energy of the city pulses with every step. Take a moment of tranquility in one of Tokyo’s serene gardens, a peaceful contrast to the urban hustle. No visit to Tokyo is complete without a stop at the majestic Meiji Shrine, a cultural landmark that stands as a testament to Japan’s deep spiritual roots. As evening falls, the city transforms into a dazzling display of neon lights, offering a vibrant backdrop to your exploration. After a day filled with captivating sights and experiences, enjoy a delightful dinner before returning to your hotel, where you can relax and reflect on the incredible day.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast before meeting your coach for an exciting journey to Hakuba, a premier skiing destination nestled in the Japanese Alps. The scenic drive, taking approximately 5 hours, will be a prelude to the winter wonderland that awaits you. Hakuba, renowned for its world-class skiing, boasts an average annual snowfall of around 14 meters, ensuring ideal conditions throughout the season, which runs from early December to April. This vibrant alpine village, once the proud host of the 1998 Winter Olympics, is a haven for winter sports enthusiasts from around the globe. With over 11 resorts scattered across the expansive Hakuba Valley, the area offers a diverse range of terrain suitable for all skill levels. Whether you're a seasoned skier or a beginner eager to learn, Hakuba promises an unforgettable experience in one of the most picturesque settings Japan has to offer.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.description: For the next five days, you’ll dive deep into the exhilarating world of skiing in Hakuba. Each morning after breakfast, you’ll head to the slopes, where the adventure begins. From 10:30 AM to 3:30 PM daily, you’ll partake in professionally guided skiing lessons tailored to all skill levels. Whether you're mastering the basics or perfecting advanced techniques, the expert instructors will ensure that each session is both fun and challenging. A supervised lunch break will provide the perfect opportunity to refuel and socialize with your peers. But the excitement doesn’t end on the slopes, after a day filled with skiing, you’ll be treated to a captivating Taiko drumming performance with dinner. This traditional Japanese art form, characterized by its thunderous beats and raw, powerful energy, is an experience like no other. The Goryu Taiko performance, renowned for its intensity and rhythmic precision, will transport you to a world where ancient traditions meet modern vibrancy. Feel the primal heartbeat of Japan as the drums echo through the night, filling the air with a sense of awe and excitement. Following the show, you’ll enjoy a delicious dinner, reflecting on the day's adventures and cultural experiences, before retiring to your comfortable accommodation for a well-deserved rest.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.description: Time to get ready for your second day on the slopes in Hakuba. After breakfast at your hotel you will make your way to the ski fields. Begin with a two-hour skiing lesson from 10:30 to 12:30, followed by a one-hour supervised lunch break. Continue the day's adventure with an afternoon ski lesson from 1:30 to 3:30.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.description: Time for another exhilarating day of skiing in Hakuba on your third ski-day. After breakfast, meet for your two-hour skiing lesson from 10:30 to 12:30, refining your skills on the slopes. Enjoy a one-hour break for lunch before diving back into the thrill with another two-hour afternoon ski lesson from 1:30 to 3:30. After a day of skiing, head out with your guide to Matsumoto Castle. Located in the city of Matsumoto, in Nagano Prefecture, Japan. Built in the late 16th century, it is one of the oldest and most well-preserved castles in Japan. Matsumoto Castle is known for its unique black color, which earned it the nickname "Crow Castle". The castle is a five-story structure with a six-story tower, surrounded by a moat and a beautiful garden. Visitors can explore the castle's interior, which features steep staircases, intricate woodwork, and displays of weapons and armor. Matsumoto Castle is a designated National Treasure of Japan and is a popular tourist attraction for its historical significance and stunning architecture. You will then enjoy dinner before heading back to your accommodation.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.description: Time for another day on the slopes in Hakuba where you will enjoy your morning and afternoon ski lessons. You will enjoy lunch on the slopes and then dinner

itinerary.label: Day 8
itinerary.description: Get ready for your last day on the slopes. You will enjoy your final two ski lessons today before your activities in the evening. As you wrap up your skiing adventure, take a moment to reflect on the progress you've made and the moments of pure enjoyment you've experienced on Hakuba's stunning slopes. After your day skiing you it is time for more fun at Hakuba Bounce. You can play in freestyle using the trampoline stretched over the floor and walls, and you can confidently enjoy the feeling of weightlessness that you cannot experience in everyday life. Afterwards you will enjoy your private dinner party at the Haku Bounce party zone.

itinerary.label: Day 9
itinerary.description: This morning, bid farewell to the snowy paradise of Hakuba as you embark on your journey back to Tokyo. Your private coach will take you on a scenic route that not only offers breathtaking views of Japan’s winter landscape but also includes stops at some of the region’s most iconic attractions. Your first stop is the world-renowned Jigokudani Monkey Park, a truly unique experience where you’ll witness the famous snow monkeys in their natural habitat. Watch in awe as these wild macaques, known for their expressive faces and playful behavior, soak in the natural hot springs, surrounded by the serene beauty of snow-covered forests. It’s a rare and heartwarming sight that perfectly captures the harmony between nature and wildlife in Japan. After this unforgettable encounter, your journey continues to Nagano, where you'll visit the historic Zenko-ji Temple. One of Japan’s most important pilgrimage sites, this ancient temple is steeped in history and spirituality. As you explore the temple grounds, take a moment to appreciate the tranquil atmosphere and admire the stunning architecture that has stood the test of time. Following these enriching experiences, your coach will carry you onward to Tokyo, where you’ll arrive at the airport for your late flight home. As you reflect on the incredible memories made over the past days— from thrilling ski adventures to cultural explorations— you'll carry with you the warmth and wonder of Japan.
